confidence_notes: Meal anchors are the strongest: several aggregated cost-of-living sites roughly agree (inexpensive meal about $2.50-3.20; mid-range three-course dinner for two about $23-24, set at $25 for tourist-centre pricing). Beer and cappuccino rest on mixed-date guides and bar listings, some older. Cocktail is cross-checked against bar listings; no restaurant glass-of-wine price was confirmed, so wine uses bottle prices and a roughly 3x-beer ratio. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no accommodation searches or listing checks were run. FX is stale: the search did not return the current RBA daily table, so the rate is the latest RBA figure it surfaced (page not opened), dated 2026-03-20 versus the 2026-11-19 generation date; refresh before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Southeast Asian tourist-town price levels as reflected in the city's own aggregated food and drink sources; accommodation tiers rely on general knowledge of the city's budget guesthouse and three-star hotel market.
